BACKGROUND

A little background

MRCH told Newsis that the lyrics were ready, but the chorus took a year to resolve. She rewrote its melody after a friend’s candid response, and felt the simpler version better suited the song’s wish to make things less complicated.

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Putting down the need to win

  • Everyday life
  • Letting go

Battle language gives ordinary distractions an outsized role: an alarm calls, a screen keeps the speaker awake, and a message unsettles them. Waving a white flag means giving up the demand to defeat every one of these small pressures. The wish is modest: some peace and a little fun.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 윤마치 · 마치

MRCH

MRCH raises a white flag in “Surrender”: even an alarm clock or a late-night message can feel like another battle. The singer-songwriter, also known as Yoon March, sings on moneto’s “She” and has her own songs to share here.

MRCH released her first EP, Let’s march!, in 2019. Her work also includes co-writing TWICE’s “Talk that Talk”. In a 2024 interview with Newsis, she described how a friend’s criticism helped her simplify the chorus of “Surrender”.
